messages.content: How do I center a div horizontally with CSS?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a concise CSS snippet to horizontally center a div. This is a straightforward direct answer.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Use `margin: 0 auto;` on a block-level div with a defined width. Example:

```css
.container {
  width: 80%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
```

Alternatively, with Flexbox on the parent:

```css
.parent {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}
```</content>
</action>
